building.name: 345 California Center
building.completed_conflict: The assessor records 345 California Street as built in 1987; Wikipedia records 345 California Center's completion year as 1986.

public_open_space.name: 345 California St - A
public_open_space.location: Plaza in front of building main entrance.
public_open_space.description: This open space is provided in the form of a large plaza fronting California Street. Additionally, two snippets can be found on the west and east sides of the building, connected by an interior walkway. The plaza and east snippet are served by restaurant

public_open_space.name: 345 California St - East B
public_open_space.location: Two snippets on either side of building main entrance, connected by walkway.
public_open_space.description: Two snippets can be found on the west and east sides of the building, connected by an interior walkway. The west snippet can be entered from Sansome Street, next to the Mandarin Hotel. There is a bench and bamboo in planters. The east snippet is on the B
